ifynwbcjkqJ-AGIl9IpV6w.zh: 美國疫情持續上升,今年截至9/28,累計47個州/地區報告3,659例確定病例、2例死亡,95%病例未接種疫苗或接種史不明,以5-19歲(1,577例)佔43%為多,其中以賓州(850例)、南卡羅萊納州(670例)及猶他州(535例)等地為主。 墨西哥疫情持續,今年截至9/28,累計報告13,484例確定病例、22例死亡,其中以哈利斯科州(Jalisco)7,266例為多、其次為首都墨西哥城(Ciudad de México)1,033例;年齡分佈以1-4歲2,692例為多,其次為5-9歲(2,398例)及25-29歲(2,234例)。 秘魯今年截至9/25,累計報告2,438例確定病例,1例死亡,為洛雷托大區(Loreto)16歲未接種疫苗男孩,因麻疹併發症(包括肺炎)死亡。由於該區地理偏遠、交通不便等因素,致疫苗接種、病例追蹤與醫療服務等,面臨挑戰。
ifynwbcjkqJ-AGIl9IpV6w.en: US measles cases continue to rise. As of 28 September this year, 3,659 confirmed cases and 2 deaths have been reported across 47 states/jurisdictions; 95% of cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history, and ages 5–19 (1,577 cases, 43%) accounted for the largest share. The largest numbers are in Pennsylvania (850), South Carolina (670) and Utah (535). Mexico's epidemic continues: as of 28 September this year, 13,484 confirmed cases and 22 deaths have been reported, with Jalisco (7,266 cases) having the most, followed by the capital, Mexico City (1,033 cases). By age, the largest numbers were among those aged 1–4 (2,692), followed by 5–9 years (2,398) and 25–29 years (2,234). As of 25 September this year, Peru has reported 2,438 confirmed cases and one death: a 16-year-old unvaccinated boy in the Loreto region who died of measles complications, including pneumonia. Because the region is geographically remote and hard to reach, vaccination, case tracing and healthcare services face challenges.

d14HJLgUrMu7aAlZBkLaUA.zh: 歐盟今年7月共計13國報告118例確定病例,以保加利亞(61 例)、義大利(29例)、西班牙(7例)、波蘭(7例)及比利時(4例)為多。近12個月(2025/8/1-2026/7/31)共計30國報告2,339例病例,其中2,012例(86.0%)經實驗室確診。個案集中於15歲(含)以上(51.2%)。ECDC評估疫情主因為部分國家疫苗覆蓋率不足、境外移入等因素,並呼籲各國提升疫苗覆蓋率至95%以上。 美洲地區疫情更新,今年截至9/5(第35週),計17個國家/地區累計報告52,676例確定病例及61例死亡(CFR:0.12%),較去年同期病例數增加約3.8倍。有99.5%的病例集中於瓜地馬拉(33,334 例)、墨西哥(12,848例)、美國(3,134例)、秘魯(1,997例)及加拿大(1,119例);泛美衛生組織(PAHO)預計今年11月進行評估墨西哥消除麻疹認證。
d14HJLgUrMu7aAlZBkLaUA.en: In July this year, 13 EU countries reported a total of 118 confirmed cases, mainly Bulgaria (61), Italy (29), Spain (7), Poland (7) and Belgium (4). Over the past 12 months (1 August 2025–31 July 2026), 30 countries reported 2,339 cases, of which 2,012 (86.0%) were laboratory-confirmed. Cases are concentrated among people aged 15 and over (51.2%). The ECDC attributes the outbreaks mainly to insufficient vaccination coverage in some countries and imported cases, and calls on countries to raise vaccination coverage to above 95%. In the Americas, as of 5 September this year (week 35), 17 countries and territories had cumulatively reported 52,676 confirmed cases and 61 deaths (CFR 0.12%), about 3.8 times the number in the same period last year. Some 99.5% of cases were concentrated in Guatemala (33,334), Mexico (12,848), the United States (3,134), Peru (1,997) and Canada (1,119). PAHO plans to assess Mexico's measles elimination certification in November this year.

lffYidjRiGEcjH1J9dxY1g.zh: 南非今年截至8/16(第33週),累計報告3,891例確定病例,較上週增加144例,1-14歲兒童佔總病例數之70%,新增病例以西開普省38例為多,其次為林波波省30例及北開普省20例;疫苗接種覆蓋率不足為主要因素,1歲以下未接種疫苗比例從2017年12.1%上升至2026年36.3%,該國優先針對未接種疫苗或尚未完整接種之兒童進行補接種作業。 秘魯今年截至第33週報告1,747例確定病例,其中以普諾地區(1,264例)為多,由於病例數增加,該國衛生部發佈流行病學警報,針對醫療機構加強流行病學監測及早期發現,並在受影響地區採取防治措施。 美洲地區疫情更新,今年截至8/8(第31週),計17個國家/地區累積報告48,690例確定病例及51例死亡(CFR:0.10%),較去年同期病例數增加約4倍,97%病例來自瓜地馬拉(31,140例)、墨西哥(12,479例)、美國(2,465例)及加拿大(1,114例),部分國家通報延遲,研判疫情可能低估。
lffYidjRiGEcjH1J9dxY1g.en: South Africa: as of 16 August this year (week 33), 3,891 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, an increase of 144 over the previous week; children aged 1–14 account for 70% of total cases. The largest numbers of new cases are in Western Cape (38), followed by Limpopo (30) and Northern Cape (20). Insufficient vaccination coverage is the main factor: the proportion of unvaccinated children under 1 year old rose from 12.1% in 2017 to 36.3% in 2026. The country is prioritising catch-up vaccination for unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated children. Peru: as of week 33 this year, 1,747 confirmed cases have been reported, mainly in the Puno region (1,264 cases). Because case numbers are rising, the Ministry of Health has issued an epidemiological alert, strengthening surveillance and early detection in healthcare facilities and taking control measures in affected areas. Americas regional update: as of 8 August this year (week 31), 17 countries and territories had cumulatively reported 48,690 confirmed cases and 51 deaths (CFR 0.10%), about four times the number in the same period last year; 97% of cases came from Guatemala (31,140), Mexico (12,479), the United States (2,465) and Canada (1,114). Because some countries reported with delays, the outbreak is likely underestimated.

B-0-ZQAXkOClaPJMSuEhvA.zh: 孟加拉疫情持續擴大,今年截至8/11,累計報告近14萬例病例其中17,385例確定病例及880例死亡(98例確定),所有行政區皆有病例,主要集中於首都達卡(Dhaka Division;60,866例、404例死亡),較為嚴重,其次為吉大港(Chattogram)及巴里薩爾(Barishal),當局持續擴大疫苗接種活動。 美洲區今年截至7月中旬,累積4,7459例確定病例,44例死亡,今年累積確定病例數相較去年同期5,123例增加8倍,且為自2004年以來確定病例數最多之一年,病例數以瓜地馬拉、墨西哥、美國及祕魯最為嚴峻,合計占該洲病例數95%,另以20-29 歲年齡組病例比例最高(31%)。 美國今年截至8/13累積報告2,566例(含16例境外移入),約19% 為5歲(含)以下兒童,67%為青少年,7%患者需住院治療。主要集中於南卡羅萊納州(670例)及猶他州(526例);賓州為目前疫情熱區,8/17當週新增60例確定病例,迄今累計307例。另93%病患為未接種疫苗或疫苗接種史不明。 瑞典今年截至8/17報告10例疑病例,可能與7/31至8/1辦理之音樂節相關,多數病例為18歲以下兒童;該國已啟動接觸者追蹤與跨國通報,並持續監測相關疫情。
B-0-ZQAXkOClaPJMSuEhvA.en: Bangladesh's epidemic continues to expand. As of 11 August this year, nearly 140,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 17,385 confirmed cases and 880 deaths (98 of them confirmed). Cases have been reported in all administrative areas and are concentrated mainly in the capital, Dhaka Division (60,866 cases, 404 deaths), followed by Chattogram and Barishal; authorities continue to expand vaccination activities. In the Americas, as of mid-July this year, 47,459 confirmed cases and 44 deaths had been reported cumulatively. Confirmed cases this year are 8 times the 5,123 in the same period last year, making this one of the years with the highest number of confirmed cases since 2004. Cases are most severe in Guatemala, Mexico, the United States and Peru, which together account for 95% of the region's cases; the 20–29 age group has the highest proportion (31%). In the United States, as of 13 August this year, 2,566 cases (including 16 imported) have been reported cumulatively; about 19% were children aged 5 and under, 67% were adolescents, and 7% of patients required hospitalisation. Cases are concentrated in South Carolina (670) and Utah (526). Pennsylvania is currently the hotspot, with 60 confirmed cases added in the week of 17 August and 307 cumulatively to date. In addition, 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Sweden reported 10 suspected cases as of 17 August this year, possibly linked to a music festival held on 31 July–1 August; most were children under 18. The country has initiated contact tracing and cross-border notification and continues to monitor the related outbreak.

SxDoTJa8ggj5Mad7MwieHg.zh: 尚比亞疫情上升,今年1月至7月3日,全國累計報告700例疑個案(含119例確定病例與4例死亡)。目前全國10個省中已有9個省份出現確定病例,其中以西部省(Western Province)最為嚴峻。高達87.4%的確定病例無疫苗接種紀錄,當局預計於7/6-11 在5個高風險地區,針對6個月至9歲兒童展開緊急疫苗接種。 瓜地馬拉疫情嚴峻且範圍持續擴大,今年截至7/5,全國累計報告逾2萬5,700例病例,其中7,260例經實驗室確診,並有24例死亡。此波疫情源自去(114)年12月的大型宗教集會,首例個案於今(115)年1/9確診。自6月中旬迄今之3週內,快速新增近9,000 例確定病例,當局正擴大疫苗接種計畫中。 美洲地區麻疹疫情嚴峻。自今年初迄6/27止,共17國累計報告逾2萬2,900例確定病例及39例死亡,較去年同期遽增181%。逾96%確定病例集中於墨西哥(11,820例)、瓜地馬拉(7,067例)、美國(2,134例)及加拿大(1,079例)。近期疫情呈下降趨勢,第23至24週病例報告數較前2週下降51.1%,主要為墨西哥、秘魯及美國病例減少;加拿大則處於疫情低點;另瓜地馬拉恐有通報延遲情形,須謹慎解讀該國疫情趨勢。
SxDoTJa8ggj5Mad7MwieHg.en: Measles is rising in Zambia. From January to 3 July this year, 700 suspected cases have been reported nationally, including 119 confirmed cases and 4 deaths. Confirmed cases have now been identified in 9 of the country's 10 provinces, with the most severe situation in Western Province. As many as 87.4% of confirmed cases had no vaccination record. Authorities plan to carry out emergency vaccination for children aged 6 months to 9 years in 5 high-risk districts from 6 to 11 July. Guatemala's outbreak is severe and continues to expand. As of 5 July this year, more than 25,700 cases have been reported nationally, of which 7,260 were laboratory-confirmed, and 24 deaths have occurred. This wave originated from a large religious gathering in December 2025, and the first case was confirmed on 9 January 2026. In the three weeks since mid-June, nearly 9,000 confirmed cases have been added rapidly, and authorities are expanding the vaccination programme. The measles outbreak in the Region of the Americas is severe. From the start of this year to 27 June, 17 countries have reported more than 22,900 confirmed cases and 39 deaths cumulatively, a sharp 181% increase over the same period last year. More than 96% of confirmed cases are concentrated in Mexico (11,820), Guatemala (7,067), the United States (2,134) and Canada (1,079). The recent trend is declining: case reports in weeks 23–24 were 51.1% lower than in the previous two weeks, mainly because of fewer cases in Mexico, Peru and the United States. Canada is at a low point. Guatemala may have reporting delays, so its trend should be interpreted with caution.

tT9I7Ozz-Y4xuXXRITLszA.zh: 秘魯普諾大區今年截至5/14報告231例確診及115例疑病例,近期疫情大幅增加且為近年來規模最大的疫情之一,該國宣布疫情為衛生緊急事件,涵蓋大都會利馬、卡亞俄憲法省及另外12個省份。另美洲地區2025年報告14,891例確診病例,高於2024年的466例。 美國疫情持續,今年迄今累計報告1,893例病例,76%為19歲以下兒童及青年,92%為未接種疫苗或接種史不明者,6%病患住院治療,病例數以南卡羅萊納州及猶他州為多,該國去年共計2,288例病例。
tT9I7Ozz-Y4xuXXRITLszA.en: In the Puno Region of Peru, 231 confirmed cases and 115 suspected cases had been reported as of 14 May this year. Recent cases have increased sharply, and this is one of the largest outbreaks in recent years. The country has declared the outbreak a public health emergency, covering the Lima Metropolitan Area, the Constitutional Province of Callao and 12 other provinces. In addition, the Americas reported 14,891 confirmed measles cases in 2025, up from 466 in 2024. In the United States, the outbreak continues: 1,893 cases have been reported so far this year, 76% of them aged 19 or under, 92% unvaccinated or with unknown vaccination history, and 6% hospitalised. Cases are most numerous in South Carolina and Utah. The country reported 2,288 cases last year.

xrr80roC5ErMIg5Y4gLi1Q.zh: WHO美洲區更新流行病學報告,該區去年共計報告46,870例確定病例,低於2024年同期(66,184例),其中以美國病例數為多,共計報告28,783例確定(含疑)病例,以11-19歲年齡層為多,其次為秘魯(4,632例),另智利(3,387例)、巴西(2,682例)、墨西哥(1,596例)、阿根廷(1,210例)及哥倫比亞(1,178例)亦報告逾千例確定病例。另美國今年截至3/27已報告2,355例確定病例。
xrr80roC5ErMIg5Y4gLi1Q.en: The WHO Americas Region has updated its epidemiological report. The region reported 46,870 confirmed cases last year, lower than the 66,184 reported in the same period of 2024. The United States reported the most, with 28,783 confirmed (including suspected) cases, mainly among people aged 11–19 years. Peru followed with 4,632 cases, and Chile (3,387), Brazil (2,682), Mexico (1,596), Argentina (1,210) and Colombia (1,178) each also reported more than 1,000 confirmed cases. In addition, the United States had reported 2,355 confirmed cases so far this year as of 27 March.

Ppn2KcGBRhKqwxgrFRUrMQ.zh: 秘魯疫情上升,今年迄今累計報告1,045例病例(含3例死亡),其中39%為確診病例,61%為疑個案。疫情已蔓延全國 23 個大區,以東北部洛雷托大區(Loreto)300例最多。當局發布警報,加強流病監測、辦理醫護臨床培訓及擴充檢驗量能,並呼籲民眾避免接觸受污染水體。
Ppn2KcGBRhKqwxgrFRUrMQ.en: Peru's outbreak is rising. So far this year, 1,045 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 3 deaths; 39% are confirmed cases and 61% are suspected cases. The outbreak has spread to 23 regions nationwide, with the most cases (300) in Loreto Region in the northeast. Authorities have issued an alert, strengthened epidemiological surveillance, provided clinical training for health care workers, expanded testing capacity, and called on the public to avoid contact with contaminated water.

NvS-hcBUZ5vJ-e-81vEZDg.zh: 美洲地區今年1-7週共4國累計34例確診病例及15例死亡(CFR:44%),分布於哥倫比亞(25例病例及13例死亡)、委內瑞拉(6例病例及1例死亡)、玻利維亞(1例死亡)及秘魯(2例病例)。自2024年9月以來,病例已發生於先前無疫情傳播地區,如亞馬遜雨林以外地區,泛美衛生組織(PAHO)發布警報,呼籲各國加強監測及疫苗接種等措施。
NvS-hcBUZ5vJ-e-81vEZDg.en: In the Americas, weeks 1–7 of this year, 4 countries reported a cumulative 34 confirmed cases and 15 deaths (CFR: 44%), distributed as follows: Colombia (25 cases and 13 deaths), Venezuela (6 cases and 1 death), Bolivia (1 death) and Peru (2 cases). Since September 2024, cases have occurred in areas with no previous transmission, including areas outside the Amazon rainforest. The Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) has issued an alert and called on countries to strengthen surveillance, vaccination and other measures.

a_P0KMoIoB9i8EecpKtOkw.zh: 秘魯2025年截止至第52週累計報告39,028例確定病例,其中54例死亡,病例數以30-59歲年齡層為多,感染風險(發病率)以12-17歲年齡層為高,其中3,760例病例經血清檢驗分型,以第3型1,774例(47.2%)為主,其次為第1型1,115例(29.7%),第2型871例(23.2%)。該國北部及亞馬遜地區於近6週病例數增加,基於即將進入雨季及氣溫不斷升高,疾病傳播風險增加,當局已發布警報,加強相關預防控制措施;該國2023-24年疫情嚴峻,每年皆報告逾25萬例。
a_P0KMoIoB9i8EecpKtOkw.en: Through week 52 of 2025, Peru reported 39,028 confirmed dengue cases cumulatively, including 54 deaths. Cases were most numerous in the 30–59 age group, while incidence (infection risk) was highest in the 12–17 age group. Of the 3,760 cases serotyped by serological testing, serotype 3 predominated with 1,774 cases (47.2%), followed by serotype 1 with 1,115 cases (29.7%) and serotype 2 with 871 cases (23.2%). Case numbers have increased in the north and Amazon regions over the past six weeks. With the rainy season approaching and temperatures rising, the risk of transmission has increased, and authorities have issued an alert and strengthened prevention and control measures. Peru experienced a severe outbreak in 2023–24, with more than 250,000 cases reported each year.

_6t02va35UfB8UTWmYQxzw.zh: 秘魯報告6例皮膚炭疽病例,病患皆有接觸感染動物,當局已啟動動物疫苗接種等防治措施,並提醒民眾倘於接觸感染動物後,出現皮膚病變(如潰瘍、黑痂等),應立即就醫治療。另倘發現有因炭疽病死亡之動物,應深埋兩公尺且不得翻動或挖掘,並通報當地衛生局或醫療機構。
_6t02va35UfB8UTWmYQxzw.en: Peru reported six cases of cutaneous anthrax, all in people who had contact with infected animals. Authorities have launched prevention and control measures, including animal vaccination, and remind people that if skin lesions (such as ulcers or black eschars) appear after contact with infected animals, they should seek medical treatment immediately. In addition, if an animal is found to have died of anthrax, it should be buried at a depth of two metres without being turned over or dug up, and the death should be reported to the local health bureau or medical institution.

0xGF5Q0WNSrT3oR8zcJtBw.zh: 美洲地區今年截至7月累計11國報告逾12,700例確診病例,其中,巴西、哥倫比亞、古巴、巴拿馬、秘魯及委內瑞拉均有報告本土病例,以往疫情主要分布於亞馬遜雨林地區,惟近2年已傳播至原流行區以外地區。泛美衛生組織(PAHO)針對美洲局部地區屈公病疫情及奧羅普切熱病例持續發生,於8/29呼籲美洲地區加強監測及病媒控制,將奧羅普切熱感染納入疑登革熱感染之鑑別診斷中,並提醒可能出現之神經系統併發症狀。
0xGF5Q0WNSrT3oR8zcJtBw.en: In the Americas, as of July this year, 11 countries had cumulatively reported more than 12,700 confirmed cases. Locally acquired cases have been reported in Brazil, Colombia, Cuba, Panama, Peru and Venezuela. Previous outbreaks were mainly in the Amazon rainforest region, but in the past two years the disease has spread beyond its original endemic areas. In view of continued chikungunya outbreaks in parts of the Americas and continued Oropouche cases, PAHO on 29 August called on the region to strengthen surveillance and vector control, to include Oropouche infection in the differential diagnosis of suspected dengue, and to be alert to possible neurological complications.

zekEQCwJMOQXY8FKV6j3Lg.zh: 美洲疫情更新,今年截至第30週共11國累計報告12,786例確診病例,其中,巴西11,888例(5例死亡)、巴拿馬501例、秘魯330例、古巴28例、哥倫比亞26例、委內瑞拉5例、蓋亞那1例、烏拉圭3例(境外移入)、智利2例(境外移入)、美國及加拿大各1例(境外移入)。受到氣候變遷等因素導致病媒─帕拉庫蠓孳生,進而造成病毒傳播至非流行地區(如古巴市區)。此外,英國亦報告3例病例,均有巴西旅遊史。去年美洲地區累計報告16,239例確診病例(4例死亡),歐洲地區亦報告30例境外移入病例。
zekEQCwJMOQXY8FKV6j3Lg.en: Americas outbreak update: as of week 30 this year, 11 countries had cumulatively reported 12,786 confirmed cases: Brazil 11,888 (5 deaths), Panama 501, Peru 330, Cuba 28, Colombia 26, Venezuela 5, Guyana 1, Uruguay 3 (imported), Chile 2 (imported), and the USA and Canada 1 each (imported). Climate change and other factors have led to proliferation of the vector, the Culicoides paraensis midge, which has spread the virus to non-endemic areas such as central Havana, Cuba. In addition, the UK reported three cases, all with travel history to Brazil. Last year, the Americas cumulatively reported 16,239 confirmed cases (4 deaths), and Europe also reported 30 imported cases.

k422FmmOJ-Ac_bIIosZw6A.zh: PAHO於5/31發布百日咳流病警報,美洲7國病例數呈上升趨勢,其中,以美國逾1萬例病例及5例死亡最為嚴峻,餘有巴西/墨西哥/厄瓜多/祕魯/哥倫比亞/巴拉圭,病例數在37-1,634例間。該地區於2012年病例數達高峰後,持續下降,惟於2023年開始上升,去年報告4.4萬例,病例數增加與新冠疫情期間疫苗覆蓋率下降相關,PAHO呼籲各國加強監測及加強疫苗接種等措施。 日本疫情持續,近1週(5/19-25)通報2,660例,較前1週2,299例增加360餘例,持續創2018年以來新高,新增病例數以新潟縣(148)為多,其次為兵庫縣(139)。今年迄今已累計逾2.2萬例,並有報告嬰兒重症及死亡案例,專家表示此次疫情嚴峻與易感性族群增加相關,由於疫情期間防護措施,導致對多種呼吸道傳染病免疫力下降,且抗藥性菌株於去年秋天以來持續傳播。今年報告2例未達接種月齡之新生兒死亡病例,且此次疫情集中於10多歲青少年族群,建議常與家中嬰幼兒接觸之家庭成員接種疫苗。
k422FmmOJ-Ac_bIIosZw6A.en: PAHO issued a pertussis epidemic alert on 31 May. Among seven countries in the Americas where case numbers are rising, the United States is the most severe, with more than 10,000 cases and 5 deaths. The others are Brazil, Mexico, Ecuador, Peru, Colombia and Paraguay, with case numbers ranging from 37 to 1,634. After peaking in 2012, case numbers in the region continued to decline, but they have risen since 2023, with 44,000 cases reported last year. The increase is associated with declining vaccination coverage during the COVID-19 pandemic. PAHO urges countries to strengthen surveillance and vaccination measures. Japan's outbreak continues: in the most recent week (19–25 May), 2,660 cases were reported, an increase of more than 360 from 2,299 the previous week, a continued high since 2018. Niigata Prefecture had the most new cases (148), followed by Hyogo Prefecture (139). So far this year, more than 22,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, and severe cases and deaths among infants have been reported. Experts say the severity of this outbreak is linked to an increase in susceptible populations: protective measures during the pandemic reduced immunity to several respiratory infectious diseases, and drug-resistant strains have continued to spread since last autumn. This year, two newborns too young to be vaccinated have died; the outbreak is concentrated among teenagers, and family members who often have contact with infants and young children at home are advised to get vaccinated.

5CH4oLH2x-o_k4TLimkPSw.zh: 美洲地區疫情更新,今年截至第20週累計221例病例(89例死亡),今年病例數約為去年同期27例之8倍,分布於巴西、哥倫比亞、秘魯、玻利維亞及厄瓜多,去年病例主要分布於亞馬遜雨林地區,惟今年已傳播至前揭地區以外之巴西聖保羅州及哥倫比亞托利馬省,且以未接種疫苗個案為多,評估美洲地區(尤其流行國家)風險為高。
5CH4oLH2x-o_k4TLimkPSw.en: Americas regional update: as of week 20 this year, 221 cases (89 deaths) have been reported cumulatively. This year's case count is about eight times the 27 cases reported in the same period last year. Cases are distributed in Brazil, Colombia, Peru, Bolivia and Ecuador. Last year's cases were mainly in the Amazon rainforest region, but this year the disease has spread beyond those areas, to São Paulo State in Brazil and Tolima Department in Colombia, and most cases were unvaccinated. The risk for the Americas, especially in endemic countries, is assessed as high.

_Qp6RbYtAK1WtBFOyssPvQ.zh: 秘魯疫情更新,今年截至4/20累計33例病例及12例死亡,病例主要分布於荒野及農業地區,並經由狩獵及農業活動而感染,其中以亞馬遜大區20例為最多,死亡病例均無接種疫苗,當局已發布警報並加強預防措施。
_Qp6RbYtAK1WtBFOyssPvQ.en: Peru update: as of 20 April this year, 33 cases and 12 deaths have been reported cumulatively. Cases are mainly in wild and agricultural areas, and infections occur through hunting and agricultural activities. Amazonas Region has the most cases, with 20. All deaths were in unvaccinated people. Authorities have issued an alert and strengthened preventive measures.

ErDra58MMvPIBu-RjQqq_A.zh: 泛美衛生組織(PAHO)發布警報,美洲近期病例數上升,2025年迄第12週累計131例病例及53例死亡,分布於巴西81例病例(31例死亡)、哥倫比亞31例病例(13例死亡)、秘魯18例病例(8例死亡)及玻利維亞1例死亡病例,大部分病例均未接種疫苗,2024年病例主要分布於亞馬遜雨林地區,惟2025年已傳播至前揭地區以外之區域。
ErDra58MMvPIBu-RjQqq_A.en: The Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) has issued an alert over rising yellow fever cases in the Americas. Through week 12 of 2025, 131 cases and 53 deaths have been reported cumulatively: Brazil 81 cases (31 deaths), Colombia 31 cases (13 deaths), Peru 18 cases (8 deaths) and one fatal case in Bolivia. Most cases were unvaccinated. In 2024, cases were mainly in the Amazon rainforest region, but in 2025 transmission has spread beyond those areas.

kJSQX6Z08MGA-oYKSebs4Q.zh: 秘魯疫情更新,今年迄今累計報告18,000餘例病例及28例死亡,主要分布於該國中北部聖馬丁大區,累計6,000餘例病例及15例死亡,該國死亡病例中有8例為兒童,可能成為今年流行型別的第3型病毒對未曾感染過該型病毒之兒童和青少年有嚴重影響。
kJSQX6Z08MGA-oYKSebs4Q.en: Peru update: so far this year, over 18,000 cases and 28 deaths have been reported cumulatively, mainly in the San Martín region in the north-central part of the country, which has accounted for over 6,000 cases and 15 deaths. Eight of the country's deaths were children. Dengue serotype 3 may become the circulating serotype this year, which could have a severe impact on children and adolescents who have not previously been infected with this serotype.

eghTNFDN4fKlcVEjuf_FWg.zh: 秘魯疫情上升,今年迄今累計19例病例,明顯高於2024年同期之2例,個案皆有林區暴露史,該國已發布警報,並採取疫情監測及疫苗接種等防治措施。
eghTNFDN4fKlcVEjuf_FWg.en: Yellow fever is rising in Peru. So far this year, 19 cases have been reported cumulatively, clearly higher than the 2 cases in the same period of 2024. All cases had exposure to forest areas. The country has issued an alert and implemented control measures, including surveillance and vaccination.

6EBBkB1YhV46yErhnWn6Zg.zh: 美洲疫情上升,泛美衛生組織(PAHO)於2/4對美洲近期病例數上升發布警報,今年1月已報告17例病例及7例死亡。2024年累計61例病例及30例死亡,高於2022-2023年玻利維亞、巴西、哥倫比亞及秘魯等國之病例數及死亡數;2024年病例主要分布於亞馬遜雨林地區,包括玻利維亞、巴西、哥倫比亞、蓋亞那及秘魯等國,今年疾病傳播至該地區以外的區域,主要分布於巴西聖保羅州、哥倫比亞托利馬省等地區;該組織呼籲加強疫苗接種措施及疫情監測。
6EBBkB1YhV46yErhnWn6Zg.en: Cases are rising in the Americas. On 4 February, the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) issued an alert over the recent increase in cases in the region. In January this year, 17 cases and 7 deaths were reported. In 2024, 61 cases and 30 deaths were reported cumulatively, higher than the case and death numbers for 2022–2023 in countries including Bolivia, Brazil, Colombia and Peru. Cases in 2024 were mainly in the Amazon rainforest region, including Bolivia, Brazil, Colombia, Guyana and Peru. This year, the disease has spread beyond that region, mainly to areas including São Paulo State in Brazil and Tolima Department in Colombia. The organization calls for strengthened vaccination and disease surveillance.

qka4XggefJqyqzeRk7T_0w.zh: 厄瓜多疫情更新,2024年累計報告6萬餘例病例及76例死亡,病例數高於2023年2萬餘例病例,今年迄今病例分布以中部納波省(899例)及東部奧雷亞納省(626例)為多。 祕魯疫情更新,該國今年迄今累計報告7,800餘例病例及6例死亡,其中,該國中北部聖馬丁大區報告約3,000例病例,該國北部皮烏拉省報告逾560例病例,尚無死亡病例。
qka4XggefJqyqzeRk7T_0w.en: Ecuador epidemic update: In 2024, Ecuador reported more than 60,000 cases and 76 deaths, higher than the 20,000+ cases reported in 2023. So far this year, cases are concentrated in Napo Province in the central region (899) and Orellana Province in the east (626). Peru epidemic update: So far this year, Peru has cumulatively reported over 7,800 cases and 6 deaths. The San Martín region in the north-central part of the country reported about 3,000 cases, and Piura Province in the north reported over 560 cases; no deaths have been reported.

5Le7wF2JlCuYzShdrD6Bzg.zh: 美洲疫情更新,今年截至11/25累計11,634例病例,其中2例死亡均來自巴西,共11國/地區報告病例,分別為巴西(9,563)、秘魯(936)、古巴(603)、玻利維亞(356)、哥倫比亞(74)、厄瓜多(2)、蓋亞那(2)及巴拿馬(1)。另美國(94)、加拿大(2)及英屬開曼群島(1)亦報告病例,皆為境外移入病例;此外,巴西已報告垂直感染確診病例。WHO評估該病毒對區域的公共衛生風險為高,對全球的風險為低。
5Le7wF2JlCuYzShdrD6Bzg.en: Americas update: As of 25 November this year, 11,634 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 2 deaths, both from Brazil. A total of 11 countries/territories have reported cases: Brazil (9,563), Peru (936), Cuba (603), Bolivia (356), Colombia (74), Ecuador (2), Guyana (2) and Panama (1). The United States (94), Canada (2) and the British overseas territory of the Cayman Islands (1) have also reported cases, all of them imported. In addition, Brazil has reported confirmed cases of vertical transmission. WHO assesses the public health risk of the virus as high for the region and low for the world.

4Ui35Mq10oz6pamSWh7Jtw.zh: 秘魯疫情更新,今年迄今累計報告273,847例病例,252例死亡,高於去年同期病例數。 泊爾疫情更新,今年迄今累計報告逾28,000例病例,12例死亡,自10月中旬以來病例數呈下降趨勢,病例主要分布於該國中部卡斯基縣。
4Ui35Mq10oz6pamSWh7Jtw.en:
Peru update: This year, a cumulative 273,847 cases and 252 deaths have been reported so far, higher than the same period last year.

Nepal update: This year, more than 28,000 cases and 12 deaths have been cumulatively reported so far. Case numbers have declined since mid-October, and cases are mainly distributed in Kaski District in central Nepal.

yS6IQ5shKM7ev5YL1T8byQ.zh: 哥倫比亞疫情更新,今年截至11/7累計26例病例,主要分布於該國中西部托利馬省,當局已實施疫苗接種措施。今年截至第35週美洲區已報告38例確診病例,其中19例死亡,疫情主要分布於哥倫比亞、玻利維亞、秘魯、巴西及蓋亞那。
yS6IQ5shKM7ev5YL1T8byQ.en: Colombia update: As of 7 November this year, 26 cases have been cumulatively reported, mainly in Tolima Department in west-central Colombia, and authorities have implemented vaccination measures. As of week 35 this year, the Region of the Americas has reported 38 confirmed cases, including 19 deaths. Cases are mainly distributed in Colombia, Bolivia, Peru, Brazil and Guyana.

KGsMtpD5lCJcXtlohtztbw.zh: 美洲疫情更新,今年1-9月累計1萬餘例病例,其中2例死亡均來自巴西,共9國報告病例,分別為巴西(8,258)、秘魯(936)、古巴(555)、玻利維亞(356)、哥倫比亞(74)、厄瓜多(2)及蓋亞那(2),另美國(90)及加拿大(2)亦報告病例,皆為境外移入病例。
KGsMtpD5lCJcXtlohtztbw.en: Americas update: From January to September this year, more than 10,000 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 2 deaths, both in Brazil. A total of 9 countries reported cases: Brazil (8,258), Peru (936), Cuba (555), Bolivia (356), Colombia (74), Ecuador (2) and Guyana (2). The United States (90) and Canada (2) also reported cases, all of them imported.
